type-only-root.review: No global element declaration; a type-only schema requires a separate validation-root/type dispatch contract.

qname-length.review: QName length/minLength/maxLength schema facets are excluded. REC validation does not measure prefix spelling; component constraints still need checking.

list-complex-assertion.review: Assertions occur inside list simple-content extension; complex assertion placement and sequence-valued $value semantics remain unqualified.

complex-value-constraint.review: Default/fixed constraints on implicit anyType or mixed complex owners remain excluded; mixed empty content is an additional blocker for schema8.

composition-route.review: Single-text execution cannot resolve includes/imports. Closed catalog support already exists, but required documents are absent from these frozen fixtures. Chameleon/import breadth/redefine/versioning can remain further blockers.

simple-assertion.review: Native integer/string assertion facets and their typed $value contexts are excluded.

type-alternative.review: Conditional type assignment remains excluded; some originals also require element wildcard, complex derivation/assertions, inheritable attributes or unbounded occurrences.

open-content.review: Explicit/default open content and element-wildcard structural validation are excluded; suffix/interleave/default applicability and mixed empty owners need distinct contracts.

default-attributes.review: Schema defaultAttributes/defaultAttributesApply group-to-use application is excluded; schema21 also imports foreign complex types. Instance default-value insertion is a separate feature.

general-identity.review: General key/keyref/unique validation is excluded; originals include scoped keys, keyref ancestor relationships and unbounded particles.

notation.review: Notation declarations and NOTATION namespace/enumeration semantics are excluded; dependent facets need separate qualification.

occurrence-breadth.review: Unbounded particles or finite reference maxOccurs=100 exceed the compile-time profile. Product schema50 also needs complex derivation/repeated outer choice; these are not primitive ID/URI/string/time defects.

unicode-regex.review: General Unicode category escape in duration pattern is outside the current finite regex subset.

named-integer-chain.review: A restriction whose named base is an integer type is excluded on the ordinary facet path by the XML Schema namespace guard, despite admitted primitive/anonymous routes.

anytype-xsi-type.review: Schema compilation succeeds; assessment refuses xsi:type selection on anyType. This is not a schema-compile failure.
